text:
[Council File 26-1420]
Motion (Rodriguez – Hutt) relative to a proposed deaccession policy for the disposition of artwork and objects in the City Art Collection that mirrors other municipalities and museums, or other industry best practices.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion calling for a deaccession policy that sets out how the city can dispose of artwork and objects in its City Art Collection, modeled on other municipalities, museums and industry best practices.
